goal: Implement Task 1 of the approved integrated plan: deterministic viewport snapshots, size/font/content-scale normalization, 65 percent initial zoom, 10-600 percent zoom bounds and compatibility-safe document normalization.
non_goals: Do not integrate draw, paste, drop, picker or AI creation paths; those belong to Task 2.
Do not implement collision, placement, permanent shell, chat HUD, AI index or credential work.
Do not install or upgrade dependencies.
Do not modify user data, installed applications, release artifacts or remote repositories.
Do not expose or modify configured provider secrets.
acceptance_criteria: A pure viewport-sizing module exports the exact Task 1 constants, snapshot and conversion APIs.
The snapshot captures finite viewport and container origin values, is immutable and uses documented last-valid/default fallbacks.
Size conversions use four-decimal persistence and two-decimal display normalization without negative zero.
CanvasNodeData fontSize accepts finite numbers and contentScale is optional with render-time compatibility normalization.
New/default template canvases start at zoom 0.65; the footer supports 0.10 through 6.00 at 0.05 steps.
Finite imported viewport values are preserved except out-of-range zoom clamp; invalid values use deterministic fallback without rewriting valid node geometry.
The focused viewport sizing tests and TypeScript typecheck pass with clean output.
The implementation is committed and independently reviewed for both spec compliance and code quality.
notes: Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for every read, search, edit and test output containing non-ASCII text.
Follow strict TDD: capture the expected failing focused test before implementation and passing focused/typecheck evidence after implementation.
Do not expand into Task 2 integration even if call sites will later consume the new APIs.
CanvasFooter is a manually bounded leaf edit in read_first context; it is not an L2 entrypoint because its React callback props expand into the entire editor and unrelated dynamic dispatch.
